CRLR No.376 of 2023
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
Present Proposed Criminal Revision has been 
filed against the order dated 03.05.2023, passed 
by learned IInd Additional Sessions Judge, 
Roorkee, District Haridwar in Sessions Trial No.15 
of 2016, “State of Uttarakhand vs. Raza Alias 
Babbu and Others”, by which, the application, filed 
by the present revisionist – victim under Section 
319 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, has 
been dismissed.
2. Heard Mr. Sajjad Ahmed, learned counsel 
(through video conferencing) and Mr. Pranav
Singh, learned counsel for the proposed revisionist 
and Ms. Manisha Rana Singh, learned AGA 
assisted by Mr. P.S. Uniyal, learned Brief Holder 
for the State.
3. Mr. Pranav Singh, Advocate, has relied upon 
a judgment of the Hon’ble Allahabad High 
Court in Bhure and Others vs. State of U.P. 
and Another, 2018(2) JIC 77 (AII) and a  judgment of the Hon’ble Supreme Court dated 
02.06.2023, passed in Criminal Appeal 
No.978 of 2022, Jitendra Nath Mishra vs. 
State of U.P. and Another.
4. Learned counsel for the State has supported 
the impugned order.
5. In the facts and circumstances of this case, it 
would be appropriate to grant an opportunity of 
hearing to the respondent no.2, the proposed 
accused, even before passing any order on 
Admission. 
6. Issue notice to the respondent no.2.
7. Steps to be taken within three days.
8. List on 07.07.2023.
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.)
 14.06.2023

Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Ramji Srivastava and Mr. Pranav
Singh, Advocates for the revisionist.
Mr. Siddharth Bisht, A.G.A. for the State.
Mr. Arvind Vashistha, Senior Advocate, 
assisted by Mr. Hemant Singh Mehra, Advocate 
for the respondent no.2.
Today, during the course of argument, it 
is argued that the Investigating Officer has 
exonerated Azhar Abbas on the basis of CCTV 
footage and call details record.
The Court wanted to know how call 
details record could be determining factor to 
rule out the possibility of Azhar Abbas at the 
place of incident?
Learned State counsel seeks time.
List on 20.02.2025 after fresh cases.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.) 
 18.02.2025
Jitendra

COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
CRLR No. 376 of 2023
Hon’ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. Ramji Shrivastava, learned counsel for the Revisionist. 
2. Mr. Vipul Painuly, learned A.G.A. for the State of Uttarakhand. 
3. Mr. Arvind Vashistha, learned Senior Advocate assisted by Mr. 
Hemant Singh Mahra, learned counsel for Respondent No. 2.
4. As per the order sheet dated 18.02.2025, the Coordinate Bench had
observed and recorded certain doubts regarding the basis on which the 
presence of a person named Azhar Abbas could be determined from the call 
detail records. It was further observed that the Investigating Officer had 
exonerated the said person solely on the basis of CCTV footage and call 
detail records.
5. On the next order sheet dated 20.02.2025, the Coordinate Bench had 
granted time to the learned State Counsel to furnish information in response 
to the queries raised in the order dated 18.02.2025, particularly as to how the 
CCTV footage and call detail records could form the basis for determining 
the presence of a person at the place of incident.
6. Learned State Counsel, however, submits that due to some 
misunderstanding, the wrong file was placed before the Court and, therefore, 
seeks further time to furnish the requisite information.
7. List this case on 14.10.2025.
8. Interim order, if any, shall remain extended till the next date of 
listing.
 (Ashish Naithani, J.) 
 07.10.2025
Shiksha
